children: Founder and CEO Daniel Wikberg presented Aira at Danske Bank Markets' investor event on 9 September. Full recording below.
Aira took part in Danske Tech Talks 2026, an investor event hosted by Danske Bank Markets, with a fifteen-minute presentation followed by Q&A moderated by Danske analysts.

Daniel Wikberg presented the company and the problem it was built to solve. Europe has no single company register. Financial statements, ownership and board data sit in 27 separate national regimes, and none of it is reachable for a general AI model, because it is not on the open internet. It has to be licensed. Aira licenses it, combines it with daily news monitoring and website data across 65 million companies in 14 European markets, and delivers it inside the CRM the customer already uses. The presentation also covered Aira Connect, the HubSpot-native product, and the route to market through HubSpot's European partner network.
Click here for full presentation, including the Q&A
All financial reports are available at www.aira.app

Aira is an AI-powered sales agent built for B2B entrepreneurs and sales professionals. The product monitors financial reports, board changes and news to surface the right moment to reach out, before the competition knows the opportunity exists. No manual data entry, no CRM admin. Just intelligence that turns signals into revenue.
Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
AI Revenue Assistant Software Stockholm AB (publ) is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market. The company's Certified Adviser is Bergs Securities AB.
